title: Import a superseded or cancelled task's lifecycle change in task-folder sync instead of refusing it as unsupported_fields
outcome: Import a superseded or cancelled task's lifecycle change in task-folder sync instead of refusing it as unsupported_fields
acceptance: An incremental task-folder import applies a peer's supersede (lifecycle, superseded_by, disposal_reason) or cancellation of an existing task the importing store holds open and unclaimed, instead of refusing it as unsupported_fields; a task with live local execution is refused by name with the reason
An exact replay of the same folder changes nothing, and the export/import round trip between two stores leaves both with the same lifecycle, replacement link and reason
A behaviour test reproduces the 2026-11-27 case: store A supersedes an open task, exports; store B imports and shows it superseded by the same replacement
